remarks: Welcome to this stylish, move-in ready tri level townhouse in the highly sought-after Green Oaks complex! Thoughtful open floor plan seamlessly connects the living room, dining room & kitchen. Updated kitchen is sure to impress, featuring quartz counters, st/st appliances & modern herringbone backsplash. Open and inviting living+dining room is perfect for entertaining, featuring updated bamboo wood flooring & sliders leading to a private spacious deck. A renovated half bath finishes off the main level. Upstairs features bamboo wood flooring, an oversized primary bedroom boasting a walk-in closet w/custom shelving. Spacious spare bedroom w/custom outfitted closet & stylish board and batten trim detail along the bedroom and staircase walls. The second floor also features a renovated full bath & bamboo wood flooring in both bedrooms. Finished lower-level offers newer luxury vinyl plank flooring ideal for a gym, media room, office and/or playroom, with additional storage in the private laundry room. Attached 1 car garage for convenient access into your unit, along w/ plenty of additional parking spaces in the parking lot. Outdoors, enjoy the oversized private deck in a sunny and quiet backyard. The park-like complex features views of the fenced in pool. Conveniently located on a quiet street, yet walking distance to shopping plazas w/ restaurants, grocery store, Home Depot, a stones throw to Old Greenwich and minutes to downtown Stamford & I-95. Highest & Best Due Tuesday 10am
